name: Local SEO Lesson - Getting a Google My Business Location
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Ways to obtain a physical address for a GBP listing, written for rank-and-rent operators.

# Options listed
- Use your real office.
- A co-working space that does not already host many GBPs (check by searching the address in Maps or the space's directory). Said to work well in dense cities.
- Use the rank-and-rent client's address with a unique suite or unit number so Google does not merge the listings.
- Buying an existing listing: the author says it works but is illegal and can be banned; US listings get banned faster than Canada, UK or Australia.

# TAG caution
TAG caution: this lesson includes tactics that violate Google Business Profile or review policies. They can get a listing suspended and are not used on TAG clients. Google's guidelines require a real, staffed location (or a service-area setup) for the business that actually serves customers. Virtual offices, invented suites and purchased listings are suspension risks.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG clients are real businesses with real locations or service areas; the useful takeaway is understanding why proximity and address placement matter, and how to spot spam competitors that use these tricks (they can be reported through Google's redressal form).
